title: fix(rest): withdrawing a public form takes effect on every anonymous intake door
body:
Fixes #21331

Clause-②: no

## Summary

Withdrawing a public form from anonymous intake now takes effect on every intake door, and the change is pinned on both sides.

- Both anonymous form routes, `GET /forms/:slug` and `POST /forms/:slug/submit`, now resolve the form through one shared resolution in `registerFormEndpoints`. That resolution reads the same state an administrator's form editor shows. No door keeps its own copy of "is this form public".
- When an administrator withdraws a form, both routes answer `404 FORM_NOT_FOUND` and no record is created. Republishing the form restores both routes.
- The resolution fails closed. If a service it depends on is registered but cannot be reached, both routes refuse the request. They do not fall back to serving the form.
- Patch changeset for `@objectstack/rest`.

The withheld detail stays off this PR, as triage directed. This PR names classes and positions only.

## Pins (both sides)

- `packages/rest/src/public-form-withdrawal.test.ts` (unit, 6 cases):
  - withdrawn: both doors `404 FORM_NOT_FOUND`, `createData` never called;
  - published (control): `200` / `201`;
  - withdrawn with nothing else to resolve: both doors refuse;
  - the no-tenancy composition unchanged;
  - unreachable dependency fails closed (`500 FORM_RESOLVE_FAILED` / `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, nothing written).
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/showcase-public-form-withdrawal.dogfood.test.ts` (live showcase boot, 4 cases). The administrator withdraws and republishes through `PUT /meta/view/...` at two scopes. After each withdrawal, both doors answer `404 FORM_NOT_FOUND` and no `showcase_inquiry` row lands. After each republish, both doors accept and the row lands.

## Verification (at `4d4d342a`)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest typecheck`: green (tsc plus `check:test-typecheck`).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: 260 files, 4988 passed, 317 skipped.
- Dogfood: `showcase-public-form-withdrawal`, `showcase-public-form`, `public-form-read-back-masking`, `form-self-auth`, `showcase-anonymous-deny` and `authz-conformance` all pass (6 files, 72 tests).
- Ablation, run from the committed fix. The fix's line was mutated on disk, `@objectstack/rest` was rebuilt, and `ablation-dist-preflight` confirmed the marker in `dist/`.
  - Unit suite: 3 failed / 3 passed. The withdrawn case and two scope controls went red.
  - Dogfood: 1 failed / 3 passed. One of the two withdrawal cases went red.
  - Restore: `git diff HEAD` empty, rebuilt, `--absent` preflight clean.
  - The first ablation attempt used a marker that the bundler constant-folded out of `dist/`. Its preflight failed, so that run is void. The second run is the one reported.
- Checklist `access-security.public-form-intake` acceptance[6] (clause 7), run by hand on a showcase boot (`objectstack dev --seed-admin`, file DB):
  - fails on `origin/main` `6d67ad5e`;
  - passes on this branch: both doors answer `404 FORM_NOT_FOUND` after withdrawal, `200` / `201` after republish, and the withdrawal persists across a restart.
- Gates: `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 68 families. 65 exit 0, including `check:type-check-debt`, which was re-run under the lock after a timeout and exited 0. Two are NOT MEASURED because of `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` (exit 3):
  - `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needs an unshallow clone;
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` needs every package's `dist/`.
- `pnpm lint` is CI-owned. ESLint was run on the 3 touched TS files only (0 errors, 0 warnings). That is not a proven narrowing.

## Acceptance notes

- One follow-up question for a deployment shape outside this card's reproduction has been reported to the dispatching seat. This PR does not change behaviour for that shape.
